description.title: חרגות פוליסה
description.summary: This table lists exclusions to a property insurance policy for fine art collectors. It details circumstances under which the insurer will not be liable for loss or damage.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מפרטת חריגות לפוליסת ביטוח רכוש לאספני אמנות של הראל. החריגות מגדירות מצבים שבהם הביטוח לא יכסה נזקים או הפסדים, כגון הזדקנות טבעית, שחיקה, פגמים מובנים, חלודה, או חשיפה לתנאי סביבה קיצוניים. כמו כן, הפוליסה אינה מכסה תיקונים, שחזורים, או נזקים הנגרמים כתוצאה ממלחמה, השתלטות ממשלתית, או תקלות חשמל ומכאניות. הראל ביטוח מציעה פוליסות ביטוח רכוש מותאמות לאספני אמנות.
notable_values: natural ageing: covered under certain conditions
breakage of brittle items: covered if caused by burglars/fire
picture glass breakage: damage to insured property is covered
unattended vehicles: not covered unless with professional carrier

sketch:
1.1 Natural ageing, gradual deterioration, inherent defect, rust or oxidization, moth or vermin, warping or shrinkage;
1.2 Repairing, restoring, retouching or any similar process;
1.3 Aridity, humidity, exposure to light or extremes of temperature unless such loss or damage is caused by storm, frost or fire, excluding loss or damage that would be recoverable under an ordinary fire insurance policy.
1.4 Breakage of articles of a brittle or fragile nature unless such breakage is caused by burglars, thieves or fire.
1.5 Breakage of picture glass, but includes damage done by broken glass to the property insured.
Loss from or damage in or on unattended vehicles, unless in the custody of a competent professional carrier.
Electrical or mechanical fault or breakdown.
The amount of the deductible stated in the Schedule for each and every loss.
Loss or damage or liability directly or indirectly occasioned by, happening through or in consequence of war, invasion, acts of foreign enemies hostilities (whether war be declared or not), civil war, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power.
Loss or damage caused by or resulting from confiscation, nationalization, requisition, or destruction of or damage to property by or under the order of any government or public or local authority.

payload:
טבלה: חרגות פוליסה
This table lists exclusions to a property insurance policy for fine art collectors. It details circumstances under which the insurer will not be liable for loss or damage.
ממדים: exclusion type, description of exclusion

1.1 Natural ageing, gradual deterioration, inherent defect, rust or oxidization, moth or vermin, warping or shrinkage;
1.2 Repairing, restoring, retouching or any similar process;
1.3 Aridity, humidity, exposure to light or extremes of temperature unless such loss or damage is caused by storm, frost or fire, excluding loss or damage that would be recoverable under an ordinary fire insurance policy.
1.4 Breakage of articles of a brittle or fragile nature unless such breakage is caused by burglars, thieves or fire.
1.5 Breakage of picture glass, but includes damage done by broken glass to the property insured.
Loss from or damage in or on unattended vehicles, unless in the custody of a competent professional carrier.
Electrical or mechanical fault or breakdown.
The amount of the deductible stated in the Schedule for each and every loss.
Loss or damage or liability directly or indirectly occasioned by, happening through or in consequence of war, invasion, acts of foreign enemies hostilities (whether war be declared or not), civil war, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power.
Loss or damage caused by or resulting from confiscation, nationalization, requisition, or destruction of or damage to property by or under the order of any government or public or local authority.
